test_item:
"ValidityCounter" is 2byte value(“0”-“65535”),a parameter of configuration file
(number of ignition cycles is 0 and does not exceed ValidityCounter)
pre:
1. DUT is connected via ADB with root permission (Dev/Eng build)
2. SAM dongle is inserted into the DUT
proc:
1. Read /data/vendor/dauth/vc on the DUT
$ adb shell cat /data/vendor/dauth/vc
2. <DUT-side trigger for SAM AuthData ignition cycle within the ValidityCounter provided by RD (X-g)>
$ <command provided by RD (X-g)>
3. Confirm the dauth log after the previous step
$ adb logcat -s dauth
er:
1. The adb shell cat /data/vendor/dauth/vc output shows the ValidityCounter value 0
2. <observable outcome provided by RD (X-g)>
3. The adb logcat -s dauth output contains the AuthData in-use entry
